teams.synopsis: Back-to-back weeks at #1, and rolling — Skattebo emerging and an Egbuka boost could make this a special squad.
teams.blurb: Back-to-back weeks at #1, GRITS is rolling, and with Skattebo emerging and Egbuka getting a boost from Evans' injury, this team looks set to keep winning. I might be bullish, but we could be watching one of the next great PFFL squads. Projected record: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: He's primetime — the WRs finally showed up with 32 combined, and Hampton is breaking out at RB.
teams.blurb: He's primetime. The starting WRs finally showed up with 32 combined points and the RBs keep impressing as Hampton breaks out. Lamar's reliable, but can Andrews stay consistent too? Addison's back now, which could give some trade value if needed. A top team in 2025 for sure. Projected record: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: Really high on this team even at 1-2 — predicting a 9-2 run over the next 11 weeks behind a healthy CMC.
teams.blurb: I'm really high on this team, even with a 1-2 start, as you can tell by my prediction of 9-2 over the next 11 weeks. 2nd in average points per week, STD is set to rack up wins as the season rolls on. CMC is a stud, and while healthy can carry them back to the playoffs. Projected record: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: Projected for a league-high 127 points in Week 4 — last week was the floor, this roster's ceiling is sky-high.
teams.blurb: Projected for a league-high 127 points in Week 4, LaPorta Potty is back towards the top after a rough Week 2. Like I said last week, Week 2 was just the floor, and the ceiling's sky-high with basically three RB1s and the WR7. Expect them to climb even more next week. Projected record: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: One of three teams at 3-0, but Lamb's injury created a real flex crisis — a Hendo breakout would help.
teams.blurb: Even as one of three teams sitting at 3-0, I've got Lambpharos at #5, thanks to Lamb's injury creating a flex crisis. Week 4 will be telling, and a trade might be needed to keep them competitive. A Hendo breakout is exactly what they need to take things up a level. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Dropped from 3rd after a rough Week 3 loss — the RB4/WR5/WR13 core is solid if the rest of the squad shows up.
teams.blurb: Dropped from 3rd after a rough Week 3 loss, but they've got a solid matchup in Week 4. Having the RB4, WR5, and WR13 is solid, but if the rest of the squad doesn't show up, you could end up in no-man's-land. On Prime Time this week, let's see what they're really made of. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Dropped 164 points in Week 3 — strong WRs and RBs plus a top-5 QB and top-3 TE make this a tough out.
teams.blurb: Before dropping 164 points in Week 3, the Minutemen looked soft, but now they've got life. Hard to complain about this roster, with strong WRs and RBs plus a top-5 QB and top-3 TE. Week 4 against LaPorta Potty won't be easy, but you can't count them out. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: The biggest riser of the week, even with Conner done and Evans banged up — Benson and Judkins are picking up the slack.
teams.blurb: Biggest riser of the week, I've got Harvey climbing even with Conner done and Evans banged up. Benson might end up outproducing what Conner was giving, and Judkins just keeps leveling up and earning more work. This week's matchup feels like the perfect test to see if the rise is for real. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Stuck in the middle of the pack — not much upside right now with the QB, WRs, and TE all disappointing.
teams.blurb: BLR's been stuck in the middle of the pack the last few weeks, and honestly, I don't see much upside right now with the QB, WRs, and TE all being disappointing. Last week's win was big, but they'll need another to stay afloat until Rice gets back. Projected record: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Nabers going down was the stab, Skattebo blowing up was the twist — stuck without an RB2 heading into a rough draw.
teams.blurb: If Tracy going down was the stab, then Skattebo blowing up was the twist of the knife. TTF's stuck without an RB2, and Chase Brown has been straight awful, making Week 4 a rough draw against a loaded opponent. Curious to see how this squad handles the next stretch, especially if they slide to 1-3. Projected record: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A huge week facing a desperate 0-3 squad — the RBs have held up, but the WRs have been brutal.
teams.blurb: Huge week for JJFC, facing a desperate 0-3 squad, but a loss here sets off alarms. The RBs have held their own and Maye looks like he's breaking out, but the WRs have been brutal, putting up under 19 a week combined. Time to find out what this team is really made of. Projected record: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: Was Week 2 just a fluke? A clear problem at WR2 and flex is dragging this team down.
teams.blurb: Was Week 2 just a fluke? This squad's got a clear problem at WR2 and flex, though Pittman Jr. can ease some of the pain. The RBs are the only thing keeping this team from sinking lower, but production from other positions will be needed to stop NY from falling to 1-3. Projected record: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: Four straight weeks in the bottom four — Higgins and Jeanty both stuck under 9 a game.
teams.blurb: I'm sorry for having hope. Just like RWB, it's four straight weeks sitting in the bottom four. The headaches start with Higgins and Jeanty both stuck under 9 points a game. The only bright spot is Warren and Bucky holding it down week after week. Gotta take advantage of a soft Week 4 matchup. Projected record: 3-11.

teams.synopsis: Four straight weeks stuck in the bottom four — talented on paper, but it just isn't clicking.
teams.blurb: RWB just hit four straight weeks stuck in the bottom four of the rankings. On paper the WR trio is nasty and the RBs are steady with the QB and TE doing their part, but it just ain't clicking. Another loss this week and the alarms are blaring, with some big changes on deck. Projected record: 3-11.
